description: Remediates CLAUDE-AUTH-006. The Tauri command `source_apply_dry_run` used to route to the inner backend command `get_repair_state`, which returned a repair-state record rather than a dry-run-specific response. The fix adds a dedicated `source_apply_dry_run` inner command in the backend command surface with a payload that explicitly declares `mode=dry_run_only` and `source_apply_attempted=false`. The Tauri driver mapping is updated so the verb matches the behavior. No real source apply is attempted.
purpose: Rung 5 of the Claude authority leak remediation campaign.
